response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL` * 1.0 / CRE) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date > '1985-04-22' AND Date < '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.status, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / m.overall AS ratio_vs_overall_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.overall IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Date is compared as stored text against '1985-04-22' and '1994-03-14' with strict inequalities, as the request specifies.
A test with CRE = 0 yields a NULL ratio (SQLite division by zero returns NULL) and is ignored in the ratio average; tests with NULL T-BIL or CRE are likewise ignored.
The overall mean is the plain average of the per-status average ratios, skipping any status whose average ratio is NULL. The NULL status group counts as one status.
